answer_2.quote: We report the accuracy of answers (Accuracy) to evaluate performance and follow ... to adopt the averaged number of generated tokens (#Token (k)) to estimate computational costs.

answer_4.quote: We randomly sample 200 step pairs from both GSM8K and MATH and hire annotators with natural language processing backgrounds to manually annotate whether they are the same steps with 0 or 1. Each annotation is double-checked to ensure its correctness.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were asked to judge whether two reasoning steps are semantically equivalent (Yes/No).
